Embassy of the Free Mind

This was the very first project I worked on. I sometimes look back at this project to see how much I've improved. They wanted a redesign and a catalog for all the books in the museum.

Radioguide

Mediahuis, through Triple, wanted a site where people can follow their favorite radio programs and compare timelines to see who is on air when. I built a mobile-first RadioGuide in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with a timeline that follows the current time and scrolls into view on load.

link to the project

Prelude Fonds

For Prelude Fonds, my team and I built an app that lets staff at Cool Kunst en Cultuur manage and lend out musical instruments. I built the filters for the instrument overview and the success and error states on the form buttons, so users always see whether their action worked. We built it with progressive enhancement.

link to the project

Tweakers

For Tweakers, I built a mobile-first community dashboard that pulls in feeds from the Tweakers forums and shows them with a chart, plus a detail page for each item. It runs on Node.js and Express and is built with progressive enhancement. The pie chart is pure CSS, dark mode follows the visitor's system setting + a hidden extra NEON mode, and smooth page transitions appear in browsers that support them.
